original_nonempty_fields.label: 539fb981ec4f024bc1dc2335
original_nonempty_fields.name: Residential Time of Use Rates
original_nonempty_fields.description: In order to benefit from Time of Use you MUST be able to coordinate most of your electric usage during the Off-Peak Hours. This means using your major appliances such as Electric Thermal Storage Heating Units, baseboard heating (if possible), electric clothes dryers, electric ovens, irons, compressors, power tools, etc. during the Off-Peak hours. Also placing timers on electric appliances like water heaters, hot tubs, saunas and freezers to only use power during Off-Peak hours will help. Any appliance you can operate during the Off-Peak hours will lower your electric utility bill.

data_dictionary.sales_mwh: Annual energy sold to ultimate consumers (MWh)
data_dictionary.revenue_thousand_usd: Annual retail revenue reported in thousands USD
data_dictionary.revenue_usd: Revenue converted from thousands USD to USD
data_dictionary.customers: Average annual customer-account count as EIA defines it
data_dictionary.average_price_cents_per_kwh: Computed realized price from EIA revenue and MWh; distinct from tariff rates
data_dictionary.tariff_rate_usd_per_kwh: Published per-kWh tariff charge by tier/TOU period
